player.name: Grunda Ironjaw
player.concept: a brutish half-orc barbarian, loud, blunt and kinder than she looks
player.build: orc barbarian 3 (Path of the Berserker), soldier background

established: When the player tried this (Lower Prout's body by hauling the hoist rope), it didn't work: The rope barely shifts under Grunda's pull: it runs over the high beam and is tied off inside the loft, beyond her reach. Prout stays hanging; Kell steps in and says, “The rope’s fastened up there, investigator. We’ll need the ladder or access to the loft.”
The full water butt is beneath Prout.
Grunda is standing on the water butt within reach of Prout.
Prout didn't hang himself: what has been found shows he was killed and then hoisted up to look like a suicide.
Cob refuses to say more about the boots or what is inside them.

opened.title: Grunda asked to inspect my boot

rulings.act: Lower Prout's body by hauling the hoist rope
rulings.why: no roll could get them that here
rulings.changed: The rope barely shifts under Grunda's pull: it runs over the high beam and is tied off inside the loft, beyond her reach. Prout stays hanging; Kell steps in and says, “The rope’s fastened up there, investigator. We’ll need the ladder or access to the loft.”

rulings.act: Heave the full water butt beneath Prout to stand on
rulings.changed: Grunda braces and drags the full butt across the cobbles until it sits beneath Prout. Kell steadies it while Grunda climbs up, bringing the body within reach

rulings.act: Persuade Cob to tell what he knows about the crackling boot
rulings.changed: Cob’s chin lifts and his hands clamp over the left boot. “Cob don’t know nothing, and you’re not having them.” He backs toward the water butt and the gap behind it; Moll shifts in front of him, keeping her eyes on Grunda
